differential.name: Gout flare
differential.rationale: History of gout and CKD with elevated pain score suggests an acute urate crystal arthritis episode.

differential.name: Arteriovenous fistula infection
differential.rationale: Dialysis dependence raises risk of access site infection presenting with pain and systemic symptoms.

differential.name: Acute coronary syndrome
differential.rationale: Ischemic heart disease, hypertension, and diabetes increase risk; pain may be atypical in the elderly.

differential.name: Dialysis‑related muscle cramps
differential.rationale: Rapid fluid removal (4.5 kg) can precipitate painful cramps during or after treatment.

differential.name: Renal osteodystrophy (uremic bone pain)
differential.rationale: CKD stage 4‑5 can cause bone pain from secondary hyperparathyroidism despite normal calcium.
